featured_reviews.review_text: I have been with Nalina since the past 7 years. She has played a very important role in my journey of fitness. featured_reviews.name: Jumana Subair
featured_reviews.review_text: I started classes here on November 31st, 2021. Still going strong. I had a synovial effusion of the knee two years ago and subsequently had disuse atrophy of muscles and chronic pain which required physiotherapy and subsequent strengthening. That is when I found Nalina, who is a very good professional fitness trainer who provides personal attention and tailors the workouts accordingly. There are different types of workouts and it is very engaging. Nalina is a nice, sweet and a strict person, which is necessary for improvement of body endurance without getting demotivated. Class timings are flexible and very accommodating. She provides diet recommendations if required. It's hard nowadays to find someone who knows what they are doing and is passionate about it, and I would recommend this place to anyone looking to be fit and healthy.

featured_reviews.name: Pallavi Tewari Madhok

featured_reviews.name: Aneesha Philip

-	Variety: There’s never a dull moment in her class. Her workouts have continually evolved from the early aerobic/ hip hop days to the advanced training I do today including reformer, spin, pilates, body weight to name a few. She’s continually innovating her workout regimen to keep it interesting and challenging
-	Wellness: Nalina doesn’t restrict her coaching only to exercise but also overall fitness by guiding us on nutrition and mental health
-	Community: Over time the 6:45 am class has become my tribe and I look forward to starting my days with them
Most of all she is personally invested in each of her students and always goes the extra mile to make sure we reach our fullest potential.

featured_reviews.name: Karishma Basantani

I would recommend Benefit Studio to anyone looking to improve their fitness.

featured_reviews.name: Meghna Dukle
featured_reviews.review_text: If you are looking to start your fitness journey and an overall lifestyle change, there is no better place than Benefit Fitness. Pankesh Sir, is one of the most positive and inspiring people I have met !! He is the best mentor for reaching your fitness goals. His focus is not weighing scales but a fitter, stronger YOU which involves customised training programs and SUSTAINABLE diets. So grateful to have come across Benefit Fitness recommended by my dearest friend who has had a beautiful transformation herself. Thank you Sir!!

featured_reviews.name: Amrit Arora
featured_reviews.review_text: I sought assistance from Pankesh of BEneFIT during a period of significant health challenges, coupled with rapid weight loss. Upon initial consultation, Pankesh adeptly identified the root cause of my issues and formulated a comprehensive plan encompassing both fitness and nutrition tailored to my specific needs. Drawing from his extensive expertise and experience, he crafted a personalized regimen that has been instrumental in restoring my health and fitness levels. Pankesh's proficiency as a rehabilitation coach is truly remarkable, as he not only provides motivation but also empowers individuals to achieve their wellness objectives. Thanks to his guidance, I have attained a level of fitness that I once deemed unattainable. I wholeheartedly recommend Pankesh for anyone seeking to optimize their health and fitness journey.

featured_reviews.name: Sushant Dhuri
featured_reviews.review_text:
7 years, many gyms, personal trainers, fad diets and no results. A friend told me about Coach Pankesh Asrani, I read a lot about his work and went for a fitness consultation session. In the first meeting itself he identified my weak areas, and suggested a suitable plan for my goals.
Its been 5 months,I have lost 4 inches from my waist and gained muscle mass, his nutrition program also helps me to stay on track, so I don't need to worry about my food even when I am traveling.
Benefit Fitness is worth every penny and trust me you cannot find a Coach as experienced and qualified as Pankesh anywhere.

featured_reviews.name: ninu khanna
featured_reviews.review_text:
Here’s my genuine and comprehensive review of the services offered by Pankesh at BEneFIT fitness studio, in physical rehabilitation, fitness, mobility training, and nutritional guidance. After training with him for over a decade, I can state unequivocally and with confidence that he is an earnest, ethical, and well-intentioned coach with immense knowledge and genuine expertise, both theoretical and practical.

I have congenital scoliosis and other age-related issues, in spite of which he has kept me pain-free and fit at 70. He’s a rehab specialist who knows exactly how to design, tailor & customize training & nutrition individually for each of his clients. It’s great to see how everyone training under his guidance—whether it is teenagers or 70 year olds like me with varied issues—benefits and is happy.

Consequently, he keeps a busy schedule due to the fact that he personalizes all his clients’ routines and does a great job with each of them. Many, like me, continue with him year after year. Thus, he is pressed for time—to those looking to join, there is a process in place which makes it easy for Pankesh and the applicant both. This is my experience from working with him over the last 10+ years and, being 70+, I definitely am grateful to Pankesh for the assistance in keeping me and my family mobile and in good health.

featured_reviews.name: Anita Jayakar
featured_reviews.review_text: Pankesh is a unique fitness trainer who brings years of experience and immense knowledge about health and body ailments to the table. He will design your workouts depending on several factors and help you with nutrition as well. Benefit Fitness is an awesome studio and Pankesh has changed the journey of fitness completely for me! I now have a sustainable program designed for my requirements and thoroughly enjoy working out :)

featured_reviews.name: Pritika Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: Joining Benefit has been a life changing experience for me! Pankesh is an extremely patient, accommodating and gifted instructor. He understands the human body well and curates a work out regimen for you specific to your needs and capabilities. He's incredibly motivating and believes in holistic fitness, and I couldn't be more happy that I joined! I've seen a huge difference in my body and wellbeing; and I only have Pankesh to thank for that. I'm so glad I chose him to help me on my path to becoming fit!

featured_reviews.name: Urvi Aradhya
featured_reviews.review_text: Genius is the word best describes Pankesh who has in depth knowledge on the subject. He is extremely inspiring and plans customised workout for you to get optimum results. I had tried various gyms and yoga classes and was never happy with the outcome but five months of personal training at Benefit Fitness under guidance of Pankesh and result is phenomenal . I dropped three sizes, gained muscles, lost fat and this is without starving myself with sustainable diet and exercise plan. I would highly recommend him to anyone who wants to be fit without any artificial harmful supplements and in a very healthy way. He is also expert on rehab so if you are suffering from any injury , he can really help you heal and gain strength.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Aken Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the pleasure of training with Danny for a couple of months and I can honestly say that he is one of the best trainers I have ever worked with. From the very first session, it was clear that Danny is passionate about fitness and dedicated to helping his clients reach their goals.

One thing that sets Danny apart from other trainers is his personalized approach. He took the time to understand my fitness goals and tailored our sessions accordingly. He pushed me to work harder than I ever thought possible, but was always encouraging and supportive along the way. He also provided valuable guidance on nutrition and lifestyle habits that complemented our workouts.

Danny's knowledge and expertise are second to none. He has a deep understanding of exercise science and is always up-to-date on the latest research and techniques. He was able to explain the rationale behind each exercise and provide modifications when needed to ensure proper form and prevent injury.

Beyond his technical skills, Danny is just a great person to work with. He has a positive, upbeat attitude that made every session enjoyable. He genuinely cares about his clients and wants them to succeed, and it shows in the level of attention and care he provides.

Overall, I would highly recommend Danny as a personal trainer to anyone looking to improve their fitness and reach their goals. He is truly one of the best in the business, and I feel lucky to have had the opportunity to work with him.

featured_reviews.name: Vishal Srivastava

You can work on a specific group of muscles and improve gradually with his support. He knows when to push you and when to take it easy. I highly recommend it especially if you have any past injury and are skeptical of following a regular gym schedule blindly.

The studio is very clean and there is everything you need, Danny sir is extremely professional, after working out my mind becomes fresh.

If you are serious and want good results then this is the best place.

featured_reviews.name: Serena D'souza

featured_reviews.review_text: I've been a happy member of Dessus Gym for a few months now. The gym is well-equipped, clean, and the staff is friendly and helpful.
